title: One Against Ten
summary: Yaoguang's ten top disciples, sent to kill Ye Fan, lose six or seven men in under two days as Ye Fan breaks through their posts. Weiwei leaves him with news that a Great Emperor's Divine Treasury has appeared at Purple Mountain, and he sends Tu Fei to warn Stone Village. The last three pursuers corner him: Yang Yi and another at Four Poles Level 1, plus one at Dao Palace Level 5. Ye Fan fights them with the Myriad Things Mother Qi Cauldron and wins, shattering the elder's divine sense inside Yaoguang's Vajra Bracelet and taking the bracelet. Back at Stone Village, an old hermit, the Red Dragon Daoist, has been buying the villagers' stone tools and cuts a treasure from Grandpa Zhang's millstone. Ye Fan follows him to Purple Mountain, where the old man, who says he was trapped on the Holy Cliff for 1,500 years, drives off two demon elders. He advises Ye Fan to reach Dao Palace Level 5 before dealing with the Holy Lands, and to ask about the ancient star road after the Four Poles.
